Nodes that lie on a cycle

Source: R/graph_queries.R
dagri_nodes_on_cycle.Rd

Internal helper for the cycle error in dagri_topo_order_impl(). The nodes Kahn's algorithm cannot emit include every in-scope cycle and also the nodes downstream of one, which are on no cycle. A node is on a cycle exactly when it can reach itself; every in-scope cycle lies inside stuck, so the search stays inside stuck. Runs only when a cycle has already been found.

Usage

dagri_nodes_on_cycle(stuck, index)

Arguments

stuck

Character vector of node ids Kahn's algorithm did not emit.

index

Adjacency index from dagri_adjacency().

Value

The ids in stuck that can reach themselves, in stuck order.
